title: Rethinking Discovery Research with AI: The promise of transdisciplinarity and the danger of reductionism
abstract: arXiv:2611.29729v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In theory, transdisciplinary research focuses on solving real-world problems without being constrained by disciplinary boundaries and methodologies. In practice, doing so is challenging, as recognized by the phrase "The world has problems; universities have departments." As a powerful integrative tool, AI may help overcome traditional reductionist approaches and enable genuine transdisciplinarity. In this essay, we discuss how this could happen and why, within the current system of incentives, it is not happening.

translated_title: 用人工智能重新思考发现研究：跨学科性的前景与还原论的危险
translated_abstract: 理论上，跨学科研究专注于解决现实世界的问题，而不受学科边界和方法论的束缚。但在实践中，这样做极具挑战性，正如那句名言所说：“世界有问题；大学有院系。”作为一种强大的整合工具，人工智能（AI）或许能够帮助克服传统的还原论方法，并实现真正意义上的跨学科研究。在本文中，我们探讨了这种情况将如何发生，以及为何在当前的激励体系下它并未发生。
tldr: 本文探讨AI作为强大的整合工具有望突破学科壁垒、克服还原论方法以实现真正的跨学科研究，但在当前学术激励体系下这一潜力尚未实现。
en_tdlr: This essay explores how AI, as a powerful integrative tool, could overcome reductionist approaches and enable genuine transdisciplinarity in discovery research, while explaining why current incentive systems prevent this from happening.
